script.problem: It has 37 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.
It has 3 sentences. A meaning is 1 or 2 sentences.

terra.problem: “Bible teachers aren't sure” does not clearly say that Calvin and Gill disagree. Calvin connects the image with the disciples not yet being ready for strict duties; Gill rejects that explanation and says fasting was unsuitable while Jesus was with them.
“Fasting” may need a simple explanation, such as going without food for a time as a religious practice.
The opening is too general: the verse describes an unshrunk cloth patch on an old garment, not every mixture of new and old things.
